snippet.title: TRILLIONAIRE MERCENARIES OF 21XX | Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5375660
https://morph.land/tmo21xx

In 21XX, humanity clings to the remains of a cyberpunk world consumed by the ocean. As corporations fight for what's left, you'll work as a mercenary for the ultra-rich, carrying out covert operations in a third-person stealth adventure that tips the balances of global power.

Play as a lone mercenary, hired by trillionaires who want to tip the global balance of power and resources. Your client, retired Trillionaire Vector Hennigan, offers you $60,000 and a 1954 Fender Stratocaster to steal one computer.

As it turns out, it was never just one job.

YOUR MISSION
Do covert dirty work like robbing a CFO's cliffside mansion. Destroy an offshore Data Center. Abduct a mad scientist from a jungle lab. Crash a Hollywood Hills rave in disguise and assassinate a CEO. Every mission is a covert operation that pushes three superpowers closer to war.

BE LIKE A SHADOW
Above all else, stealth! Mark guards, stay out of sight, put whole patrols to sleep or cloak and slip past. Scan a target's face and walk in as them. When it all goes wrong, fight your way out. Every mission is ranked, with main and side objectives.

YOUR OWN PRIVATE ARMY
Unlock over 100 playable characters by capturing them on missions. Most soldiers you meet would love to stop working for tech lords if they had anywhere else to go. Give them somewhere. Knock out the best of them and extract them to Stillwater, your base on the ocean, then put them to work under your own flag. Befriend animal buddies, like an arctic fox or raptor, who will fight at your side.

THE OPEN SEA
An open world ocean. Sail between islands, arctic vaults, resorts and cities of the future. Throw yourself off cliffs on a hang glider and race the highways of the Outer Rim on a light bike.

MULTIPLAYER
Play the whole story with a friend on the same couch in split-screen co-op. You're never tied together: split up and hit a base from two sides, have one of you mark targets while the other moves in, or go loud together when the plan falls apart.

Take on players online in head-to-head versus matches across custom arenas, or race them on light bikes around the circuit, with or without AI rivals.

- Over 20 story missions

- Upgrade paths for weapons, gear, and characters

- Full story playable in local split-screen co-op

- Online versus and online racing

- 100+ unlockable characters

- a fully function cyberpunk-themed DAW

Ideas of a world order are gone. Get paid.

Made by solo developer Morph
